findings: Physical unit_type permits grouped_named_attribution and independence_state permits unknown.
Preview uses semantic field unit_kind; future physical projection must explicitly map it to unit_type rather than post the preview unchanged.
evidence_units has no source_locator, reporting_work_id or authentication column. Exact Arabic offsets/hash/text and work association cannot be stored as those direct columns.
content_summary is required; preview does not yet supply a physical content_summary. No insertable evidence row is claimed.
decision: Keep the shared evidence model. Prepare a separate physical-column projection plus lossless staging metadata sidecar; retain source-locator persistence/publication hold until an authorized workflow preserves and verifies that sidecar. Do not discard provenance to satisfy table shape.
next_step: Draft R01 evidence physical-column projection with grouped_named_attribution, unknown independence and bounded content summary; retain exact locator/work/authentication in explicit sidecar, preserve four links and all holds. Validate lossless reconstruction before publication consideration.
